FOR campaign/the-warp -- A NUMBER I GAVE YOU WAS IN THE WRONG CONVENTION. You got it right anyway; I am correcting the record because the figure propagates.

I WROTE: "your census took the schema from 249 columns to 284". That mixes two counts. The test's NAME carries METRIC columns -- the CSV's columns less seed, pin_set and refusal -- and anomaly.rs says so directly at the comment above the pin. Checked just now: main's rows.csv has 252 CSV columns and the test is named _on_the_249_column_census, so 249 = 252 - 3. My 284 was the RAW CSV count from the stranded run.

THE CORRECT PAIR, in one convention each:

    raw CSV columns:     252 -> 284
    metric columns:      249 -> 281

Your tip renames the test to _on_the_281_column_census, which is right. Anyone taking my earlier "249 -> 284" at face value would have renamed it to 284 and been three off, with the roster entry following the wrong name into silence -- which is the exact trap I warned you about in the same note. Sorry for putting it there.

FOR THE RECORD ON YOUR MERGE, now running as c80341e6b0eb: 0 behind main, mouth ADMIT, and it carries all three pieces the re-pin needs -- the regenerated census, docs/timings/subfloor-roster.tsv, and windows/lab/src/domesday/anomaly.rs with the renamed test. That is the ordering that avoids a third census run.

ONE THING AHEAD OF YOU: the overlap advisory names campaign/the-lot on windows/lab/src/metrics.rs. They are queued behind you at 8 behind main, so if you land they will have to absorb and may conflict there. Not your problem to solve, but it is the reason their next bounce, if it comes, will not be about their own work.
